text: DP-700 groups into three skills-measured domains, each weighted roughly a third of the exam. There's no domain you can skip or cram at the expense of the others.
Domain one: implement and manage an analytics solution. Domain two: ingest and transform data. Domain three: monitor and optimize a solution. Each sits in roughly the 30-35% range.

Domain one maps to Fabric Chapter 1 — workspaces, OneLake, Lakehouses, Warehouses, capacities. Domain two maps to Fabric Chapter 2 plus Databricks Delta Lake mechanics — pipelines, Dataflows, Eventstreams, notebooks, Spark.
Domain three maps to Fabric Chapter 3's production practices — the Monitoring Hub, Direct Lake Mode performance, capacity and SKU sizing, CI/CD, and incident response.
Missing an entire domain costs roughly a third of the exam. Next up: a direct drill on Domain 1 — implementing and managing an analytics solution.
